sources.excerpt: Published on July 31, 2011 VFE Pedals compressor distortion octave fuzz (1 octave up) pedal Information VFE Pedals The Triplet combines 3 classic circuits into one pedal - Orange Squeezer compressor, Green Ringer analog octave, and Blue Clipper distortion. Each has it's own on/off toggle switch, plus a FILTER control has been added to the distortion section to shape the treble response.
